anomalies.description: A person lies motionless on the road while another individual in dark clothing kneels beside them, appearing to strike or restrain them; nearby armed personnel observe without intervening. This constitutes abuse of a helpless victim.

A large, sudden explosion occurs in the distance, producing a rapidly expanding mushroom-shaped plume of dark smoke and dust that rises vertically and spreads outward. The blast is clearly visible from frame f4 onward, with peak development by f6–f7.; A large, violent explosion occurs off-road to the right, producing a rapidly rising column of dark smoke and dust; the blast is fully developed by f1 (16.5s) and continues expanding through f7 (19.0s), with visible ground disturbance and debris ejection.

A second, distinct explosion occurs further down the road at approximately 23.0s, characterized by a bright fireball and rapid smoke plume engulfing a vehicle; visible in f14 and f15, with initial flash at f14 (23.0s) and expanding smoke at f15 (23.5s).
A large, sudden explosion occurs on a vehicle on the road ahead, producing a bright fireball followed by a massive plume of smoke and debris; visible in frames f5 through f10.

Two armed individuals in military attire are engaged in close physical contact near the roadside barrier; one appears to be restraining or grappling the other while both are crouched amid smoke and dust.

In the immediate aftermath of the explosion, one individual in military-style attire is seen leaning over and appearing to strike or restrain another person lying on the ground; the victim appears incapacitated and unable to resist.
A large plume of dark smoke and debris erupts suddenly from the left side of the frame, expanding rapidly upward and rightward, consistent with a high-energy explosion.
